svg.title: Lupus classification by the 2019 EULAR/ACR criteria: an ANA of at least 1:80 is required to enter; then score the highest item in each of seven clinical and three immunologic domains, and 10 or more points with at least one clinical item classifies the patient as having SLE

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif
Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: SLE classification (2019 EULAR/ACR): ANA ≥ 1:80 to ENTER, then ≥ 10 POINTS

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: count only the HIGHEST item per domain · need ≥ 1 clinical item · classification, not diagnosis

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: lecture's case: malar 6 + joints 6 + platelets 4 + anti-Sm 6 + low C3 and C4 4 = 26 → SLE

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: CLINICAL domains: at least ONE needed
